description: Calling a namespaced function that the application didn't define is an evaluation error
notes: The spec has no namespaced function names, so ns::f() would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go) and reports the unknown function during evaluation (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
reference_error: There are no functions in namespace "ns::"
